info.title: Zaminnegar API
info.description:
Farmland management API. Geometry is GeoJSON in WGS 84 (EPSG:4326) with `[longitude, latitude]` ordering. Errors raised by the application share one envelope (`ErrorResponseDto`); request validation errors use `ValidationErrorResponseDto`.

**Authentication.** Register with `POST /auth/register` and confirm the phone with `POST /auth/register/verify`, then `POST /auth/login` with username and password. The server answers with an HTTP-only session cookie, which the browser sends on every later request (the session identifier never appears in a response body). A user has one session at a time; it ends after an idle period or an absolute deadline. A missing, invalid or expired session gives `401`; a valid session without the required permission gives `403`.

**Authorization.** Permissions come from roles stored in the database: a *system role* (held once, applies to every project) and one *project role* per project membership (applies to that project only; custom roles belong to a single project). A project or record you have no relationship with answers `404`.
